reference_status: automatic stored corpus labels; agreement, not human-validated accuracy

statistics.repetition_policy: average two outcomes within item before resampling the same 30 frozen batches
statistics.intervals: Descriptive paired 95% percentile intervals without multiplicity adjustment; no significance declarations

metric_notes.feature_components: Feature sets are scored irrespective of type; joint requires stress and feature-set agreement. Invalid outputs contribute all reference features as FN.
metric_notes.core_joint: Remove COPY and MOSAIC from prediction and reference before exact joint comparison.
metric_notes.empty_sets: Valid empty/empty item F1=1; invalid F1=0; undefined aggregate micro F1=null.
metric_notes.stability: Both repeats must be valid with identical type/set. Different frozen E demonstrations confound decoding with example variability.
metric_notes.cost: Physical calls counted once in grand total. Standalone R/V/W adds the reused S call. Cost is reported API USD, with missingness retained. Latency sums measured stages, excluding queue time. Administrative continuation histories are retained; all prior attempts, including billing rejections with unmeasured cost, are included once.

scope: positive automatic-reference pool, not rhyme detection
balancedstress sample is not corpus prevalence
verifier feedback is related to the label-producing system, so agreement gains are not independent accuracy gains
source corpus systematically omits some COPY/MOSAIC features emitted by live verifier; full-set primary is literal stored-label agreement; core joint metric is a prespecified sensitivity analysis
no poem identifiers, only pair duplicate filtering
full context condition is text extraction with documented source recovery
Original OpenAI-family results used Codex CLI; extension uses a direct API. Interface, serving and reasoning differences confound cross-model comparisons.
Exact request model IDs do not independently attest immutable model weights; provider/model metadata are retained.
Synthetic access checks may determine access/settings before this freeze; panel/labels/settings cannot change in response to main scores.
